attributes.name: Raytheon Company
attributes.blurb: Defense contractor; merged with UTC. Surviving company exists as a subsidiary of the renamed UTC, company, Raytheon Technologies
attributes.summary:
Raytheon is a major American defense contractor that specializes in defense and homeland security technology. As the world’s largest producer of guided missiles, Raytheon specializes in manufacturing defense systems and defense electronics. 

A member of the defense electronic industry, Raytheon is most active lobbying on defense, homeland security and federal budget appropriation issues.

attributes.name: Thales-Raytheon Systems Company LLC
attributes.blurb: Air operation command and control systems and battlefield radars
attributes.summary: ThalesRaytheonSystems’ ground-based radars are capable of detecting both traditional and unconventional threats for homeland and tactical air defense, counter-battery and weapons system coordination.

attributes.name: Raytheon Polar Services Company
attributes.blurb: Formed specifically to meet the needs of the National Science Foundation's Office of Polar Programs.
attributes.summary:
Multifaceted Directed Energy Weapons Platform. 

RPSC has assembled an exceedingly qualified and experienced management team to lead our performance on NSF's Science, Operations and Maintenance Support contract of the United States Antarctic Program.

Under contract to the National Science Foundation, Raytheon Polar Services Company is responsible for science, operations, and maintenance services at three locations in Antarctica -- McMurdo Station, Amundsen-Scott South Pole Station and Palmer Station as well as at Christchurch, New Zealand; Punta Arenas, Chile; and Port Hueneme, California. RPSC's program management office is in Denver, Colorado.

We will do all that we can to effect a smooth transition of contract responsibilities. Our Phase-In plan is designed to facilitate an efficient and seamless assumption of contract performance -- including seeking qualified and experienced incumbent employees. We are very pleased to be here!
